column1: # Protection Cell Air-Defense Coverage - scenario laydown
# Unclassified planning vignette over a Baltic area of operations. All place
# names are publicly known geography; friendly locations are well-known NATO
# air-defense (IADS) entries are open-source (OSINT) coverage ESTIMATES derived
# from publicly reported nominal system ranges. No classified data is included.
# Format (comma-separated). Lines beginning with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#     kind           ASSET (friendly) or THREAT (hostile air defense)
#     type           friendly asset class or hostile SAM class (drives the SIDC)
#     wez_radius_km  weapon-engagement-zone radius in km (THREAT only; blank for ASSET)
# --- Hostile integrated air defenses (OSINT coverage estimates) --------------
